steps.text: Manage card limits from the limits screen.

sections.name: ATM Withdrawal Limit
options: Customer can disable ATM withdrawal limit (enabled by default)
Customer can enter the desired limit not to exceed the maximum limit set by the bank

sections.name: Card Payment Limit
options: Customer can disable card payment limit (enabled by default)
Customer can enter the desired limit not to exceed the maximum limit set by the bank

sections.name: Online Purchase Limit
options: Customer can disable online purchase limit (enabled by default)
Customer can enter the desired limit not to exceed the maximum limit set by the bank

sections.name: Contactless Limit
options: Customer can enter any amount below 300
